in_sanskrit.name: Rupesh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Wealthy
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Rupesh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Rupesh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rup', which means 'wealth'. The name is often given to boys born into wealthy families, or as a wish for prosperity and wealth in the future.
